title: Role Upgrade Proposal: Lead Community Moderator
body:
## **Date: September 19th, 2022**

**FrogMan/Rama**
**Discord: Frogman#1959 **
**Telegram: @binaryxx**

Hello Community,

I started contributing to the Edgeware Ecosystem back in December ’21 as a Community Moderator and have been actively involved in various activities in the Edgeverse since then. I have also been actively presenting my weekly deliverables to the community in the Weekly Plan and Mission Calls being held every week. Apart from that, I have also been making infographics for various events in Edgeverse.

And I will actively be making infographics for every upcoming event in Edgeware and Kabocha. So here I propose to share the Infographics Creation responsibility for Edgeware Community along with Kabocha. I am highly inspired by our ex-community contributor Johan and I have learnt a lot from his work. I would continue to improve my skills to learn more. I would do my work with dedication and punctuality. 

**Current contributor title:** Senior Community Moderator ([Previous Role Upgrade SCU proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6311-role-upgrade-proposal-senior-community-moderators))
**New (Proposed) contributor title:** Lead Community Moderator
**Add-on responsibilities:** Infographics Creation for announcements, tweets, etc.
**Contributors with direct working relation for the add-on responsibilities:** Gagan (Social Media Manager), Shankar (Community Operations Lead)
